entries.title: Psalms 31:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 31:2
segments: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me. {my...: Heb. to me for rock of strength}

words.text: me. {my...: Heb. to me for rock of strength}

entries.title: Psalms 31:3
segments: For thou [art] my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:4
segments: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou [art] my strength.

words.text: for me: for thou [art] my strength

entries.title: Psalms 31:5
segments: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

entries.title: Psalms 31:6
segments: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 31:7
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

entries.title: Psalms 31:8
segments: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

words.text: And hast not shut me up

entries.title: Psalms 31:9
segments: ¶Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, [yea], my soul and my belly.

entries.title: Psalms 31:10
segments: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

entries.title: Psalms 31:11
segments: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:12
segments: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel. {a broken...: Heb. a vessel that perisheth}

words.text: . {a broken...: Heb. a vessel that perisheth}

entries.title: Psalms 31:13
segments: For I have heard the slander of many: fear [was] on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

entries.title: Psalms 31:14
segments: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my God.

entries.title: Psalms 31:15
segments: My times [are] in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:16
segments: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

entries.title: Psalms 31:17
segments: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, [and] let them be silent in the grave. {silent...: or, cut off for}

entries.title: Psalms 31:18
segments: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous. {grievous...: Heb. a hard thing}

entries.title: Psalms 31:19
segments: ¶[Oh] how great [is] thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; [which] thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

entries.title: Psalms 31:20
segments: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

entries.title: Psalms 31:21
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city. {strong: or, fenced}

words.text: : for he hath shewed me his marvellous

entries.title: Psalms 31:22
segments: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 31:23
segments: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: [for] the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

entries.title: Psalms 31:24
segments: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
